Operations.Name: CertificateCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a new Certificate

Certificates are classified under following types and the necessary keywords to be passed
for `create_type` attribute to create the respective type of certificate

1) Imported Certificate                 -  CERTIFICATE_CREATE_IMPORTED

2) Certificate Signing Request          -  CERTIFICATE_CREATE_CSR

3) Imported Certificate Signing Request -  CERTIFICATE_CREATE_IMPORTED_CSR

4) ACME Certificate                     -  CERTIFICATE_CREATE_ACME

By default, created CSRs use RSA keys. If an Elliptic Curve Key is desired, it can be specified with the
`key_type` attribute. If the `ec_curve` attribute is not specified for the Elliptic Curve Key, then default to
using "SECP384R1" curve.

A type is selected by the Certificate Service based on `create_type`. The rest of the values in `data` are
validated accordingly and finally a certificate is made based on the selected type.

`cert_extensions` can be specified to set X509v3 extensions.

Operations.Name: CertificateDelete
Operations.Description:
Delete certificate of `id`.

If the certificate is an ACME based certificate, certificate service will try to
revoke the certificate by updating it's status with the ACME server, if it fails an exception is raised
and the certificate is not deleted from the system. However, if `force` is set to True, certificate is deleted
from the system even if some error occurred while revoking the certificate with the ACME Server

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the certificate to delete.

Arguments.Name: force
Arguments.Description: Whether to force deletion even if certificate is in use.

Fields.Name: CSR
Fields.Description: PEM-encoded Certificate Signing Request (CSR) data. `null` for imported certificates or completed     ACME certificates.

Fields.Name: DN
Fields.Description: Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate subject in RFC 2253 format. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: Acme
Fields.Description: ACME registration and account information used for certificate lifecycle management. `null` for     non-ACME certificates.

Fields.Name: AcmeUri
Fields.Description: ACME directory server URI used for automated certificate management. `null` for non-ACME certificates.

Fields.Name: AddToTrustedStore
Fields.Description: Whether this certificate should be added to the system's trusted certificate store.

Fields.Name: CertType
Fields.Description: Human-readable certificate type, typically 'CERTIFICATE' for standard certificates.

Fields.Name: CertTypeCA
Fields.Description: Whether this certificate is a Certificate Authority (CA) certificate.

Fields.Name: CertTypeCSR
Fields.Description: Whether this entry represents a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) rather than a signed certificate.

Fields.Name: CertTypeExisting
Fields.Description: Whether this is an existing certificate (imported or generated).

Fields.Name: Certificate
Fields.Description: PEM-encoded X.509 certificate data. `null` for certificate signing requests (CSR) that have not yet     been signed.

Fields.Name: CertificatePath
Fields.Description: Filesystem path to the certificate file (.crt). `null` if no certificate is available.

Fields.Name: Chain
Fields.Description: Whether this certificate has an associated certificate chain. `null` if unavailable.

Fields.Name: ChainList
Fields.Description: Array of PEM-encoded certificates in the certificate chain, starting with the leaf certificate.

Fields.Name: City
Fields.Description: City or locality name from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: Common
Fields.Description: Common name (CN) from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: Country
Fields.Description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: CsrPath
Fields.Description: Filesystem path to the certificate signing request file (.csr). `null` if no CSR is available.

Fields.Name: DigestAlgorithm
Fields.Description: Cryptographic hash algorithm used for certificate signing (e.g., 'SHA256'). `null` if unavailable.

Fields.Name: DomainsAuthenticators
Fields.Description: Mapping of domain names to ACME DNS authenticator IDs for domain validation. `null` for non-ACME     certificates.

Fields.Name: Email
Fields.Description: Email address from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: Expired
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate has expired. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: Extensions
Fields.Description: X.509 certificate extensions parsed into a dictionary structure.

Fields.Name: Fingerprint
Fields.Description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate in hexadecimal format. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: From
Fields.Description: Certificate validity start date in ISO 8601 format. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for this certificate entry.

Fields.Name: KeyLength
Fields.Description: Size of the cryptographic key in bits. `null` if key information is unavailable.

Fields.Name: KeyType
Fields.Description: Type of cryptographic key algorithm (e.g., 'RSA', 'EC', 'DSA'). `null` if key information is unavailable.

Fields.Name: Lifetime
Fields.Description: Certificate validity period in seconds. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Human-readable name for this certificate. Must be unique and contain only alphanumeric characters,     dashes, and underscores.

Fields.Name: Organization
Fields.Description: Organization name from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: OrganizationalUnit
Fields.Description: Organizational unit from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: Parsed
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate data was successfully parsed and validated.

Fields.Name: Privatekey
Fields.Description: PEM-encoded private key corresponding to the certificate. `null` if no private key is available or for     imported certificates without keys.

Fields.Name: PrivatekeyPath
Fields.Description: Filesystem path to the private key file (.key). `null` if no private key is available.

Fields.Name: RenewDays
Fields.Description: Number of days before expiration to attempt automatic renewal. Only applicable for ACME certificates.     `null` for non-renewable certificates.

Fields.Name: RootPath
Fields.Description: Filesystem path where certificate-related files are stored.

Fields.Name: San
Fields.Description: Subject Alternative Names (SAN) from the certificate extension. `null` if no SAN extension is present.

Fields.Name: Serial
Fields.Description: Certificate serial number. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: State
Fields.Description: State or province name from the certificate subject. `null` if not specified.

Fields.Name: SubjectNameHash
Fields.Description: Hash of the certificate subject name. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: Type
Fields.Description: Internal certificate type identifier used to determine certificate capabilities.

Fields.Name: Until
Fields.Description: Certificate validity end date in ISO 8601 format. `null` if certificate parsing failed.

Fields.Name: AddToTrustedStore
Fields.Description: Whether to add this certificate to the trusted certificate store.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: Certificate name.

Fields.Name: RenewDays
Fields.Description: Days before expiration to attempt renewal.

Models.Name: ExtendedKeyUsage
Models.Description: Extended Key Usage extension configuration specifying certificate purposes.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether the Extended Key Usage X.509 extension is present in the certificate.

Fields.Name: ExtensionCritical
Fields.Description: Whether the Extended Key Usage extension is marked as critical. If `true`, applications that do not understand     this extension must reject the certificate.

Fields.Name: Usages
Fields.Description: Array of Extended Key Usage (EKU) purposes that define what the certificate may be used for     (e.g., 'SERVER_AUTH', 'CLIENT_AUTH', 'CODE_SIGNING').

Models.Name: KeyUsage
Models.Description: Key Usage extension configuration defining permitted cryptographic operations.

Fields.Name: ContentCommitment
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate may be used for non-repudiation (proving content commitment).

Fields.Name: CrlSign
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate may be used to sign Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs).

Fields.Name: DataEncipherment
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate's public key may be used for directly encrypting raw data.

Fields.Name: DecipherOnly
Fields.Description: Whether the public key may only be used for decryption when `key_agreement` is also set.

Fields.Name: DigitalSignature
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate may be used for digital signatures to verify identity or integrity.

Fields.Name: Enabled
Fields.Description: Whether the Key Usage X.509 extension is present in the certificate.

Fields.Name: EncipherOnly
Fields.Description: Whether the public key may only be used for encryption when `key_agreement` is also set.

Fields.Name: ExtensionCritical
Fields.Description: Whether the Key Usage extension is marked as critical. If `true`, applications that do not understand     this extension must reject the certificate.

Fields.Name: KeyAgreement
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate's public key may be used for key agreement protocols (e.g., Diffie-Hellman).

Fields.Name: KeyCertSign
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate may be used to sign other certificates (CA functionality).

Fields.Name: KeyEncipherment
Fields.Description: Whether the certificate's public key may be used for encrypting symmetric keys.
